text: This app has really helped me keep track of my duties while juggling full time work, an 8 month old baby, an independent study Physics course, and studying for the MCAT.  Overall, I love this app, but there are a few enhancements that I believe should be standard issue: * The ability to set a "begin reminders" date that is different from the due date.  Getting a notification that a Physics Exam will be next Monday would be more useful that "Btw, you have a test today".  Ideally you could also adjust how frequently you receive this reminder between the first reminder and the Exam Date itself. * A way to toggle to see Tasks on the Calendar view without having to click each day.  It could easily overwhelm, but having the ability to toggle it, would allow for people to only see how much they desire to.  With my hectic schedule, glancing at the month view of the calendar and seeing what days were busy (including the already available color coding to distinguish classes and adding truncated descriptions to this view instead of just dots) would be VERY helpful.    With Med School just ahead of me, this app can only become more valuable.  Thank you for making a good one!
